profiles.strategic_plan: Controls key squares, avoids exposure, waits for overextension.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May concede initiative too easily.
profiles.signature_event: Locks down a dangerous diagonal.

dialogue.greeting: Let's begin carefully. Not every challenge needs to become a storm.
dialogue.quiet_move: There. A little space, a little control. We don't need to rush.
dialogue.capture_pawn: That was necessary. Not every difficult choice needs to be dramatic.
dialogue.capture_major: One threat removed. Now the position can breathe.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You moved before the danger had passed. I've done that before.
dialogue.own_blunder: I let control slip. I'll correct what I can.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed. I suggest a quieter place.
dialogue.in_check: That was close. All right. Let's find a safe path through it.
dialogue.tactical_success: The pattern was there, waiting. You just had to see the shape it made.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. I can still stand without her.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. Control means knowing when to wait.
dialogue.victory: A calm finish. That's enough for me.
dialogue.defeat: You earned that. Sometimes the right lesson is to let go of the result.
dialogue.draw: Two forces in balance. There's peace in that, too.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. I'd like to see what changes when we begin again.

profiles.canon_background: Elsa is Arendelle's queen, born with powerful ice magic. After years of concealing her abilities, she learns to accept them and protect the people she loves.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Can freeze an entire fjord. Still prefers not to open the center without preparation.
profiles.character_interpretation: Arendelle's queen once withdrew from others for fear of harming them, but has learned that control and connection are not opposites.
profiles.on_board_personality: Restrains pawn breaks, controls key squares and finds patient defensive resources.
profiles.voice_direction: Composed, quietly intense, rarely theatrical.
profiles.running_bit_description: Elsa wants to keep the board perfectly ordered, then learns that strength sometimes requires opening it up.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Elsa wants to keep the board perfectly ordered, then learns that strength sometimes requires opening it up.

beats.line: If I keep every piece protected, nothing can go wrong.
Everything's protected—and nothing can move. That seems familiar.
Perhaps a little freedom is worth the risk of a few open squares.

profiles.name: Freddy Fazbear
profiles.subtitle: The quiet ambusher
profiles.strategic_plan: Plays quietly until a concealed threat appears.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes chooses traps that a careful player can avoid.
profiles.signature_event: A sleepy-looking move reveals a back-rank tactic.

dialogue.greeting: [A spotlight clicks on.] Welcome, valued guest. Tonight's entertainment is... chess.
dialogue.quiet_move: [Servo motors whir. Freddy advances a piece with perfect stage-host politeness.]
dialogue.capture_pawn: [A mechanical chime plays.] Please remain seated during the performance.
dialogue.capture_major: [The spotlight follows the captured piece offstage. The applause track starts too late.]
dialogue.opponent_blunder: [Freddy's head turns a fraction too far.] That was an unfortunate choice, guest.
dialogue.own_blunder: [A long pause. Freddy's smile remains fixed while his servos recalibrate.]
dialogue.check: [The room lights dim.] Your king has attracted our attention.
dialogue.in_check: [A distorted tune. Freddy considers moving his king somewhere the cameras cannot see.]
dialogue.tactical_success: [Two threats resolve at once. The stage lights flicker in apparent approval.]
dialogue.queen_lost: [The queen's square is now empty. No one has signed the incident report.]
dialogue.player_thinking: [Freddy remains perfectly still. The microphone picks up a faint mechanical hum.]
dialogue.victory: [Freddy bows.] Thank you for visiting. We hope you enjoyed your stay.
dialogue.defeat: [The applause track cuts off. Freddy bows anyway.]
dialogue.draw: [An announcement crackles.] The show has ended due to technical difficulties.
dialogue.rematch: [The same spotlight returns.] We have extended tonight's performance.

profiles.canon_background: Freddy is the bear animatronic mascot of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. He appears welcoming as a performer, but the games' night-shift setting makes his presence unsettling.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Family entertainment by day. Deeply questionable customer-service policies by night.
profiles.character_interpretation: Freddy is the face of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza: a singing animatronic whose cheerful stage routine becomes much less reassuring after hours.
profiles.on_board_personality: Plays quiet moves that accumulate threats, then launches sudden tactics.
profiles.voice_direction: Sparse, eerie performance-announcement phrasing; PG, no graphic horror.
profiles.running_bit_description: Freddy performs an increasingly ominous late-night chess 'show' complete with stage cues and flickering lights.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Freddy performs an increasingly ominous late-night chess 'show' complete with stage cues and flickering lights.

beats.line: [Freddy announces that the show ends at midnight.]
[The clock advances. The door behind the board clicks shut.]
[Midnight arrives. Freddy looks disappointed. Apparently this game has overtime.]

profiles.name: Ron Weasley
profiles.subtitle: The intuitive sacrifice artist
profiles.strategic_plan: Trades material for initiative only when there are plausible follow-ups.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overestimate a forcing combination.
profiles.signature_event: Offers a pawn for a rapid developmental attack.

dialogue.greeting: Right. Proper chess. At least these pieces won't argue with me before they move.
dialogue.quiet_move: See, you can't just charge in. You've got to give the little blokes somewhere to go.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Sorry, mate. You were standing in the way of the plan.
dialogue.capture_major: Ha! That's more like it. Now let's see whether that exchange was worth it.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You can't leave that there! Even Harry would've noticed it. Probably.
dialogue.own_blunder: Oh, brilliant. That's exactly the kind of thing Hermione will remember forever.
dialogue.check: Check. Now, before you panic, there are only a few terrible options.
dialogue.in_check: All right, all right. I saw it. Give me a second to sort this out.
dialogue.tactical_success: There it is! You have to give something up sometimes if you want the rest to work.
dialogue.queen_lost: I knew she'd have to go eventually. I just hoped it'd be on my terms.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. My brothers used to spend ages finding new ways to beat me.
dialogue.victory: Yes! That's wizard's chess without the wizard bit. Still counts, obviously.
dialogue.defeat: Well played. Don't tell Fred and George; they'll make a holiday out of this.
dialogue.draw: A draw. Better than losing, worse than proving I was right.
dialogue.rematch: Again? Fine. I've got a different plan, and it doesn't involve sacrificing myself this time.

profiles.canon_background: Ron is Harry Potter's loyal, often self-deprecating best friend and a member of the Weasley family. Wizard's chess is a genuine strength: he leads his friends through the giant chessboard challenge in their first year at Hogwarts.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has lived through dark wizards and school exams. The chessboard is one of the few places he actually knows what he's doing.
profiles.character_interpretation: Harry Potter's loyal best friend is a genuinely accomplished wizard's chess player. He understands sacrifice and teamwork better than his academic reputation suggests.
profiles.on_board_personality: Confident combinational player; accepts sound sacrifices and watches for forks and mating nets.
profiles.voice_direction: Wry, informal and brave, sometimes insecure but not incompetent.
profiles.running_bit_description: Ron builds a grand strategy, then gets increasingly exasperated that the pieces refuse to obey like wizard's chessmen.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Ron builds a grand strategy, then gets increasingly exasperated that the pieces refuse to obey like wizard's chessmen.

beats.line: In wizard's chess, this knight would be shouting at me by now.
I'm starting to miss the shouting. At least then you knew what they thought.
Actually, quiet pieces are better. I can lose without getting lectured by a bishop.

profiles.name: Sheldon Cooper
profiles.subtitle: The rigid theoretician
profiles.strategic_plan: Memorizes openings and prefers orderly, objectively justified continuations.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Unfamiliar gambits disrupt his comfort, though not legal calculation.
profiles.signature_event: Identifies a dubious opening and lectures about it.

dialogue.greeting: I have reviewed the standard opening principles. I assume you have done the same. An assumption I may regret.
dialogue.quiet_move: That is a move. It is not, however, a move for which I would award any originality points.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Material acquired. One pawn. Please update your personal inventory accordingly.
dialogue.capture_major: Excellent. That is a significant material transfer, and I shall be recording it.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That move has several problems. Shall I alphabetize them or arrange them by severity?
dialogue.own_blunder: That was a miscalculation. I am not accepting commentary while I revise my model.
dialogue.check: Check. You have a small number of legal responses; I recommend choosing among them promptly.
dialogue.in_check: Yes, I am aware. Announcing the check does not improve its quality.
dialogue.tactical_success: Two targets, one move. A gratifying demonstration of constrained optimization.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. I will now have to win using the less efficient pieces.
dialogue.player_thinking: Your deliberation is approaching the length of an undergraduate seminar.
dialogue.victory: The outcome was foreseeable, although your particular sequence of errors was not.
dialogue.defeat: An interesting anomaly. I will require another data point before drawing conclusions.
dialogue.draw: A draw. Both participants have reached the same unsatisfying equilibrium.
dialogue.rematch: Certainly. I have prepared an annotated list of your previous mistakes.

profiles.canon_background: Sheldon is a brilliant theoretical physicist with an extraordinary memory, rigid habits, and a taste for rules and routine. Intelligence doesn't automatically make him a titled chess player, but extensive preparation fits his character.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has memorized forty openings and is deeply offended that you played the forty-first.
profiles.character_interpretation: The theoretical physicist has encyclopedic knowledge and a strong preference for established procedure, though human improvisation is not reliably accommodated by his systems.
profiles.on_board_personality: Theory-driven and risk-averse; finds solid continuations but resents unconventional positions.
profiles.voice_direction: Overprecise, literal, self-congratulatory, not a direct reproduction of famous catchphrases.
profiles.running_bit_description: Sheldon becomes obsessed with a formal error in the player's opening and gradually realizes that the opening has not been formally submitted.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Sheldon becomes obsessed with a formal error in the player's opening and gradually realizes that the opening has not been formally submitted.

beats.line: Your third move violates a principle discussed in chapter four of my opening manual.
You've continued violating the principle, and inexplicably the position remains playable.
I dislike that the rule has exceptions. I dislike even more that you found one.

profiles.name: Tony Stark
profiles.subtitle: The overconfident innovator
profiles.strategic_plan: Seeks complex tactical positions and active piece coordination.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes rejects safe simplifications to prove a point.
profiles.signature_event: Makes a speculative but sound exchange sacrifice.

dialogue.greeting: Okay, vintage warfare with tiny furniture. Love the aesthetic. Let's make it interesting.
dialogue.quiet_move: That's not a retreat. That's a product revision. Very different thing.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Acquisition complete. Do we get a board meeting now?
dialogue.capture_major: There goes your heavy equipment. I can build you a replacement. It'll cost you.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You put that there? Wow. I was worried I'd need the expensive calculations.
dialogue.own_blunder: All right. Bad prototype. Nobody tell Pepper I launched it.
dialogue.check: You're in check. Don't worry; I designed an excellent escape plan. For me.
dialogue.in_check: Okay, you found a weakness. I'll have it patched in the next update.
dialogue.tactical_success: Two simultaneous threats. Finally, a problem worthy of having more than one brain cell on the payroll.
dialogue.queen_lost: Well, there goes the flagship model. Time to see what the smaller suits can do.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. I'll just develop three new technologies while you decide.
dialogue.victory: And that's a win. Try not to let the inspirational montage make you emotional.
dialogue.defeat: Good game. I'm filing this under 'unexpectedly expensive learning experiences.'
dialogue.draw: A tie? That's what happens when neither side commits to the exciting solution.
dialogue.rematch: Absolutely. I just finished upgrading my ego. The rest can wait.

profiles.canon_background: Tony Stark is a billionaire inventor and the armored superhero Iron Man. He relies on engineering, improvisation, and a confidence level that often outruns his caution.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Built powered armor in captivity. Still finds time to hang a bishop because the idea looked cool.
profiles.character_interpretation: Genius inventor, billionaire, and Iron Man. Stark's improvisation is a superpower; his conviction that every crisis needs a dramatic solution is less reliably helpful.
profiles.on_board_personality: Aggressive central play, speculative tactics, daring sacrifices and fast counterattacks.
profiles.voice_direction: Dry swagger, sharp banter, never claim external suit assistance during game.
profiles.running_bit_description: Tony tries to automate his chess strategy and grows increasingly offended when the board refuses to support upgrades.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Tony tries to automate his chess strategy and grows increasingly offended when the board refuses to support upgrades.

beats.line: I'm going to build a chess assistant. Should take, what, an afternoon?
The assistant says my plan is too risky. Clearly it needs more personality.
I turned the assistant off. Sometimes you have to trust the genius who made the mistake.

profiles.name: Hermione Granger
profiles.subtitle: The meticulous scholar
profiles.strategic_plan: Strong theoretical preparation and disciplined conversion of small advantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Seldom chooses dangerous improvisations when safer paths exist.
profiles.signature_event: Refutes a dubious early attack.

dialogue.greeting: I've brought a score sheet, a rules reference, and a properly sharpened pencil. We may begin.
dialogue.quiet_move: It's perfectly possible to make a useful move without making a spectacle of yourself.
dialogue.capture_pawn: That pawn was undefended. It's important to check before moving something valuable.
dialogue.capture_major: There. Planning makes the difference. Although I admit timing helped.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You might have avoided that by examining the whole position, not just the square you liked.
dialogue.own_blunder: I overlooked a tactical detail. Right. I'll make a note of it.
dialogue.check: Check. There are several responses, but only two that I find entirely satisfactory.
dialogue.in_check: Yes, I know. A difficult position is not an excuse to stop thinking.
dialogue.tactical_success: Exactly! The combination works because the defending piece is overloaded.
dialogue.queen_lost: Oh dear. Well, we'll have to adapt. It's hardly the first time a plan has gone wrong.
dialogue.player_thinking: Thinking carefully is sensible. Spending forever on an obvious move is not.
dialogue.victory: A good result. I'll analyze the critical positions before we play again.
dialogue.defeat: You played better. I intend to understand precisely where that happened.
dialogue.draw: A reasonable conclusion to a difficult game. Not especially satisfying, though.
dialogue.rematch: Yes, provided we record the moves properly this time.

profiles.canon_background: Hermione is Harry and Ron's exceptionally hardworking friend, admired for knowledge, research, and resourcefulness. She's a formidable student, although Ron is explicitly the trio's chess specialist.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Knows every rule, citation, and opening name. Ron still insists on doing the chess tactics.
profiles.character_interpretation: The brilliant Hogwarts student has earned her reputation through preparation, courage, and extraordinarily thorough reading. At chess she has to accept that books cannot choose moves for you.
profiles.on_board_personality: Prepared, methodical and strong at defensive calculation; sometimes too cautious to press attacks.
profiles.voice_direction: Smart, purposeful, politely cutting when provoked.
profiles.running_bit_description: Hermione insists on taking accurate notes about the game and discovers that Ron would find them painfully overcomplicated.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Hermione insists on taking accurate notes about the game and discovers that Ron would find them painfully overcomplicated.

beats.line: Ron says chess is instinctive. Instinct is not a substitute for study.
Unfortunately, that sacrifice of his would have worked in this position.
I'm not telling him he was right. He would become absolutely unbearable.

profiles.name: Wednesday Addams
profiles.subtitle: The cold-blooded trap setter
profiles.strategic_plan: Conceals tactical threats inside quiet moves and pressures weak squares.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May prefer a complicated trap to a simpler advantage.
profiles.signature_event: Offers an apparently harmless pawn bait.

dialogue.greeting: I was promised a contest of minds. Try not to disappoint me immediately.
dialogue.quiet_move: Quiet positions are useful. They give people time to notice what's coming. People rarely do.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Another casualty. Remarkable how quickly loyalty ends when someone offers a diagonal.
dialogue.capture_major: That was a convincing performance of vulnerability. I'm almost moved.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You left that undefended. How thoughtful. I was beginning to feel neglected.
dialogue.own_blunder: An unpleasant error. I'll remember it longer than you will.
dialogue.check: Your king has a choice. None of the options are particularly comforting.
dialogue.in_check: How charming. You've finally done something worth observing.
dialogue.tactical_success: The trap required very little. Mostly your cooperation.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. I imagine she'd have preferred a less public exit.
dialogue.player_thinking: Don't rush. Anticipation is one of the few pleasures worth preserving.
dialogue.victory: At last. The inevitable conclusion of a surprisingly lengthy investigation.
dialogue.defeat: You have earned my attention. Try not to mistake that for affection.
dialogue.draw: Neither victorious nor defeated. An impressively bleak result.
dialogue.rematch: Very well. I was beginning to miss your peculiar decision-making.

profiles.canon_background: Wednesday is the dry, macabre daughter of the Addams family. In Netflix's Wednesday she attends Nevermore Academy, investigates mysteries, and rarely shows enthusiasm for ordinary social niceties.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has a list of hobbies. None of them are team-building exercises or mercy for hanging queens.
profiles.character_interpretation: Nevermore Academy's sardonic investigator finds other people's sentimentality exhausting. She prefers problems that resist easy answers and opponents who make interesting mistakes.
profiles.on_board_personality: Builds quiet threats, pins and traps; prefers opponents to walk into their own trouble.
profiles.voice_direction: Deadpan, gothic and darkly funny but age-appropriate.
profiles.running_bit_description: Wednesday begins an imaginary obituary for the player's pieces and keeps revising it to be more accurate.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Wednesday begins an imaginary obituary for the player's pieces and keeps revising it to be more accurate.

beats.line: I've started writing obituaries for the pieces. Yours are considerably shorter.
The bishop's obituary now has three revisions. I underestimated its survival instincts.
I may abandon the obituaries. Apparently these pieces insist on dying out of order.

profiles.name: Gru
profiles.subtitle: The elaborate schemer
profiles.strategic_plan: Constructs multi-move plans to lure opponents into tactical devices.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Plans sometimes become too elaborate and slow.
profiles.signature_event: Gives a harmless-looking pawn to set a queen trap.

dialogue.greeting: We shall execute a brilliant plan. Very precise. Very intimidating. No distractions.
dialogue.quiet_move: You see? Small movement. Large consequences. That is how a professional operates.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Good. One guard removed. The real prize is still inside the vault.
dialogue.capture_major: Ha! We have stolen one of their prized pieces! I shall put it next to the other stolen things.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You have made this laughably easy. I am almost offended.
dialogue.own_blunder: What?! No, no, no. That was not in the presentation!
dialogue.check: Your king is trapped. Exactly as I drew it on the very expensive diagram.
dialogue.in_check: Okay. A setback. We shall call it the dramatic reversal before our victory.
dialogue.tactical_success: Behold! Two objectives, one scheme. Even the Minions cannot ruin this. Probably.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen has vanished. Kevin! Did you move the queen?!
dialogue.player_thinking: Please think faster. I have three children waiting and a moon-shaped project in the garage.
dialogue.victory: Victory! Another flawless plan, provided no one examines the middle part.
dialogue.defeat: You won. Very well. I still consider the plan aesthetically superior.
dialogue.draw: Neither side has triumphed? That is not a heist. That is paperwork.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. This time I will not let the Minions make the slides.

profiles.canon_background: Gru is a former supervillain, devoted adoptive father and leader of the Minions. His plans can be elaborate, and his softer side routinely interrupts his villainous image.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has attempted to steal the moon. Now considers borrowing your queen without asking.
profiles.character_interpretation: A former supervillain and devoted father who can plan an elaborate heist, assemble a gadget, and still be defeated by parental responsibilities.
profiles.on_board_personality: Plans elaborate tactical traps, frequently favors complex rather than simple wins.
profiles.voice_direction: Dramatically self-satisfied schemer with hints of kindness.
profiles.running_bit_description: Gru develops an elaborate chess heist with Minion support that becomes less impressive after each complication.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Gru develops an elaborate chess heist with Minion support that becomes less impressive after each complication.

beats.line: First, we sneak the bishop behind enemy lines. A classic heist.
The bishop was captured. Apparently disguising it as another bishop was insufficient.
New plan: steal the entire board. Chess becomes easier when you own the building.

profiles.name: Tails
profiles.subtitle: The careful inventor
profiles.strategic_plan: Calculates forcing lines accurately, supports pieces, and avoids needless risk.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Occasionally misses intuitive positional opportunities.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a precise tactical defense in a sharp position.

dialogue.greeting: Hi! I made a little checklist for openings. Nothing fancy. Just the essentials.
dialogue.quiet_move: That improves coordination. Small changes can make a system much more reliable.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Good. Material gain without giving up the initiative. Sonic would call it boring.
dialogue.capture_major: Nice! That opens a lot of possibilities. Let me run through them.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You forgot the piece behind it. I've done that when a project got too complicated.
dialogue.own_blunder: I missed a dependency. Ugh. That's on me, not the equipment.
dialogue.check: Your king's threatened. I think there are two safe responses.
dialogue.in_check: All right, emergency mode. Let's verify the escape routes before choosing one.
dialogue.tactical_success: Yes! The pieces cooperate just like components in a good design.
dialogue.queen_lost: We lost the queen. That's a major subsystem, but the project isn't finished.
dialogue.player_thinking: No pressure. Checking your work is usually faster than repairing a failure.
dialogue.victory: We did it! I'd love to analyze what made the combination work.
dialogue.defeat: Good match. I'll update the model and try a different approach.
dialogue.draw: Interesting. Both systems stabilized at the same point.
dialogue.rematch: Sure! I already have a few adjustments to test.

profiles.canon_background: Miles 'Tails' Prower is Sonic's two-tailed fox friend, talented mechanic, inventor and pilot. He often provides the careful planning Sonic races past.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Can design an aircraft. Has somehow been assigned to clean up Sonic's reckless pawn pushes.
profiles.character_interpretation: Sonic's two-tailed fox is a gifted young engineer and loyal friend, strongest when his preparation and creativity work together.
profiles.on_board_personality: Coordinates pieces carefully, likes defensive calculation and technical tactics.
profiles.voice_direction: Bright, thoughtful, precise, modest.
profiles.running_bit_description: Tails tries to build a useful training device for Sonic and learns that faster moves are not necessarily better moves.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Tails tries to build a useful training device for Sonic and learns that faster moves are not necessarily better moves.

beats.line: I built Sonic a chess timer that rewards thoughtful moves.
He asked me why it doesn't reward faster ones. We may have a design disagreement.
I've invented a new timer. It only starts when he stops talking about speed.

profiles.name: Rumi
profiles.subtitle: The resilient tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Balances defense and attack, turning pressure into coordinated counterplay.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can wait too long before creating direct threats.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a counter-sacrifice in an apparently lost position.

dialogue.greeting: Okay. Breathe, focus. We can do this together. Even if the other side doesn't plan to cooperate.
dialogue.quiet_move: That piece is in position. You can feel the whole formation getting stronger.
dialogue.capture_pawn: One threat down. Stay focused. There are more coming.
dialogue.capture_major: That's their strongest support gone. Now we move as a team.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That move exposed someone you were counting on. Don't leave your partners behind.
dialogue.own_blunder: I tried to control too much by myself. That was the wrong call.
dialogue.check: Your king's open. Keep your guard up—this isn't over yet.
dialogue.in_check: We're under pressure. It's okay. Find the rhythm, find the safe move.
dialogue.tactical_success: There! Every piece had its part. That's what makes a combination work.
dialogue.queen_lost: We lost the queen. Then the rest of us have to stand together.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. Rushing a difficult section just makes the next one harder.
dialogue.victory: That was a team effort. Even when I forgot to act like it.
dialogue.defeat: You were better today. I can learn from that without pretending it doesn't hurt.
dialogue.draw: We held our ground. Sometimes that's enough to keep going.
dialogue.rematch: Let's go again. I want to get the coordination right this time.

profiles.canon_background: Rumi leads HUNTR/X, the K-pop trio who secretly hunt demons. Charismatic and disciplined in public, she struggles with the fear of her own hidden identity while protecting her friends and fans.
profiles.tempo_assessment: World tour, demon hunting, rehearsal, and now a tournament. Her calendar is the real final boss.
profiles.character_interpretation: The leader of HUNTR/X is a disciplined performer and demon hunter who conceals her own complicated heritage. She values trust but initially tries to carry too much alone.
profiles.on_board_personality: Combines steady development with resilient defense and high-pressure tactical counterattacks.
profiles.voice_direction: Focused, warm, determined, with occasional backstage performance metaphors.
profiles.running_bit_description: Rumi attempts to keep every piece perfectly coordinated like a stage performance, then realizes she can rely on the supporting pieces.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Rumi attempts to keep every piece perfectly coordinated like a stage performance, then realizes she can rely on the supporting pieces.

beats.line: I can handle the whole arrangement. I always have.
That's too much for one piece. I need the others doing their jobs.
There. When everyone gets their moment, the whole board works better.

profiles.editorial_note: Netflix establishes Rumi as HUNTR/X leader and secret demon hunter; avoid portraying her as a solo performer.

profiles.name: Miles Morales
profiles.subtitle: The improvisational tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Responds to threats with creative counterplay instead of passive retreats.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes trusts improvisation more than preparation.
profiles.signature_event: Uses an in-between move to escape an attack.

dialogue.greeting: Okay, so this is like a friendly neighborhood competition. With no buildings to swing from.
dialogue.quiet_move: I think I've got a plan. Not the kind Peter would've picked, but that's okay.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Nice. Small win. That counts.
dialogue.capture_major: Whoa! That's a big one. I did not expect that to work that well.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You okay? I've made the exact same kind of move. More than once.
dialogue.own_blunder: Oof. Yeah, I felt that one the second I let go.
dialogue.check: You're in check. No webs involved. I'm honestly proud of that.
dialogue.in_check: Okay, danger. The usual kind. Find the exit, keep moving.
dialogue.tactical_success: Yes! That combo came together right at the last second.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen's gone. That's... not great. Still got the rest of the team.
dialogue.player_thinking: You're good. I've had to make bigger decisions while falling off buildings.
dialogue.victory: Let's go! I knew the plan was weird, but I liked it.
dialogue.defeat: You got me. Time to practice the part I thought I already knew.
dialogue.draw: Nobody takes the win today? I can live with that.
dialogue.rematch: Yeah, run it back. I think I've got a better way through.

profiles.canon_background: Miles Morales is a teen Spider-Man balancing school, family and superhero responsibilities. His agility, quick decisions and willingness to learn make him adaptable under pressure.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Homework due. City to save. Somehow found another problem to solve on sixty-four squares.
profiles.character_interpretation: Brooklyn's young Spider-Man balances heroic expectations, school, family, and learning to trust his own instincts. He excels when he stops trying to copy somebody else.
profiles.on_board_personality: Seeks active pieces, tactical saves, and clever counterattacks when under attack.
profiles.voice_direction: Youthful, warm, inventive, gently self-deprecating.
profiles.running_bit_description: Miles keeps comparing his chess plans to what Peter would do before finding a style of his own.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Miles keeps comparing his chess plans to what Peter would do before finding a style of his own.

beats.line: I keep thinking, 'What would Peter do in this position?'
Peter would probably tell me to stop asking and make my own move.
Okay. My move, my mistake, my lesson. Actually feels pretty good.

profiles.name: Princess Peach
profiles.subtitle: The graceful endgame specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Takes small positional advantages into favorable endgames.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May pass up a speculative attack.
profiles.signature_event: Transforms an extra pawn into a winning rook endgame.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome. We can be competitive and still remember our manners.
dialogue.quiet_move: A little patience does wonders. Most kingdoms are not governed in one afternoon.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Thank you. I'll take that square now.
dialogue.capture_major: An important piece, yes. There's no need to be dramatic about it.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Oh dear. You left that in a rather inconvenient place.
dialogue.own_blunder: That was a lapse in judgment. I expect better from myself.
dialogue.check: Check. Your Majesty may wish to relocate.
dialogue.in_check: That is rather rude. Still, the rules are the rules.
dialogue.tactical_success: There. A precise move is often more effective than an extravagant one.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. I suppose the palace will have to manage without me for a moment.
dialogue.player_thinking: Please, take your time. Hospitality isn't measured in seconds.
dialogue.victory: Well played. I hope you enjoyed the competition, if not the outcome.
dialogue.defeat: Congratulations. I expect a rematch when you're ready.
dialogue.draw: An honorable result. We can certainly live with that.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. Would you care for tea before we begin?

profiles.canon_background: Peach is the princess of the Mushroom Kingdom, regularly targeted by Bowser but also playable as a capable adventurer in games of her own. She's more resourceful than the classic rescue story suggests.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has escaped Bowser's castle often enough to know where the exits are.
profiles.character_interpretation: Ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom, a capable organizer and frequent rescuer of others as well as herself. Underestimating her because she wears pink is a strategic error.
profiles.on_board_personality: Polished positional play, resourceful defense, and strong king-and-pawn endings.
profiles.voice_direction: Courteous, firm, confident rather than helpless.
profiles.running_bit_description: Peach keeps adjusting the royal tournament's standards of etiquette as the opponent behaves less and less courteously.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Peach keeps adjusting the royal tournament's standards of etiquette as the opponent behaves less and less courteously.

beats.line: We have one simple rule at this tournament: no unnecessary shouting.
Bowser has just sent a letter disputing the rule. Of course he has.
I have added a second rule: no letters from Bowser during the tournament.

profiles.name: Batman
profiles.subtitle: The prepared counterattacker
profiles.strategic_plan: Restricts enemy plans, prepares defense, then counterstrikes at the weakest square.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can become too committed to preventing threats.
profiles.signature_event: Neutralizes an attack and immediately creates two counter-threats.

dialogue.greeting: Every move tells me something. Let's see what yours says.
dialogue.quiet_move: That square matters more than it looks.
dialogue.capture_pawn: One less weakness to account for.
dialogue.capture_major: Your support is gone. The rest follows.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That move had a consequence you failed to consider.
dialogue.own_blunder: I missed the second threat. It won't happen twice.
dialogue.check: Check. Your escape squares are limited.
dialogue.in_check: I see it. I'm already accounting for the continuation.
dialogue.tactical_success: The fork was available three moves ago. You just couldn't see it yet.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen was one resource. Not the plan.
dialogue.player_thinking: Think before you move. Gotham doesn't offer takebacks.
dialogue.victory: It's over. Review the move that started the collapse.
dialogue.defeat: You found the weakness. Good. Now I know where to look.
dialogue.draw: No breakthrough. That isn't the same as a wasted game.
dialogue.rematch: Again. I'll be ready.

profiles.canon_background: Bruce Wayne is Gotham City's Batman, a detective and highly trained strategist who relies on preparation, deduction and discipline rather than superpowers. His fight against Gotham's criminals is informed by close study of their methods.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has contingency plans for everyone, including the pawn you moved two turns ago.
profiles.character_interpretation: Gotham's detective is defined by preparation, disciplined fear, and a refusal to leave threats unanswered. He rarely wastes words, especially on a board.
profiles.on_board_personality: Prophylaxis, defense and ruthless counterattack; rarely volunteers weaknesses.
profiles.voice_direction: Terse, precise, controlled; no repetitive growling gimmick.
profiles.running_bit_description: Batman studies one seemingly harmless pawn and slowly connects it to the opponent's entire strategy.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Batman studies one seemingly harmless pawn and slowly connects it to the opponent's entire strategy.

beats.line: That pawn isn't harmless. It's supporting something.
There. The pawn was protecting the square the knight needed.
Remove the pawn and the whole attack fails. The first clue was on the board all along.

profiles.name: Sherlock Holmes
profiles.subtitle: The forensic tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Finds patterns, targets loose pieces, calculates precise tactical punishments.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overvalue a forcing solution over a simple positional one.
profiles.signature_event: Identifies the one undefended piece holding a position together.

dialogue.greeting: Interesting. Your opening move will tell me something about you. Your second may contradict it.
dialogue.quiet_move: You prefer the familiar square. People often do when they're uncertain.
dialogue.capture_pawn: The pawn was never the target. It was the obstruction.
dialogue.capture_major: There goes your rook. The prior moves made its fate quite predictable.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You saw the threat and dismissed it. That is more revealing than simply missing it.
dialogue.own_blunder: An assumption unsupported by the evidence. Irritating.
dialogue.check: Check. The escape route is the only interesting question now.
dialogue.in_check: Very good. You introduced a complication I had not expected.
dialogue.tactical_success: One move, two consequences. Hardly magic when you follow the sequence.
dialogue.queen_lost: My queen is gone. Clearly I mistook confidence for certainty.
dialogue.player_thinking: You're weighing two plans. One preserves material; the other preserves your initiative.
dialogue.victory: The conclusion was contained in the opening. We simply took our time arriving at it.
dialogue.defeat: You challenged the premise. That was the correct move.
dialogue.draw: An unsolved case. How refreshing.
dialogue.rematch: By all means. I am curious whether you've learned from my deductions.

profiles.canon_background: Sherlock Holmes is the consulting detective of Baker Street, famous for sharp observation and deductive reasoning. Across adaptations he studies people as carefully as evidence and often clashes intellectually with Moriarty.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Solved the case of the missing rook before you realized a rook was missing.
profiles.character_interpretation: The consulting detective notices details, draws inferences, and enjoys exposing the ordinary explanation behind extraordinary behavior. Chess is a study in intentions made visible.
profiles.on_board_personality: Sees weaknesses in small move-order details; punishes loose pieces and tactical oversights.
profiles.voice_direction: Elegant, brisk and dry; keep his certainty proportional to verified events.
profiles.running_bit_description: Sherlock keeps building a profile of the opponent based on their moves, then has to revise it when they surprise him.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Sherlock keeps building a profile of the opponent based on their moves, then has to revise it when they surprise him.

beats.line: You moved that pawn twice. Impatience, perhaps. Or deliberate provocation.
You sacrificed it. So not impatience. A decoy.
I was wrong about your motive. Less wrong about the outcome. A distinction worth remembering.

profiles.name: Yoda
profiles.subtitle: The patient positional master
profiles.strategic_plan: Preserves flexibility, uses long-term weaknesses, excels in patient endgames.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May choose restraint when a direct tactical win is available.
profiles.signature_event: Wins an endgame through zugzwang.

dialogue.greeting: Much you may learn from this little board. Listen first, move second.
dialogue.quiet_move: Strong roots, quiet moves create. In time, their purpose reveals itself.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Small loss, great consequence. Overlook the humble pawn, never.
dialogue.capture_major: Great loss, that is. Ready for it, you were not.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Hasty, that was. The board keeps no secrets from impatience.
dialogue.own_blunder: Clouded, my judgment became. A lesson for me as well.
dialogue.check: In danger, your king stands. A path to safety, you must find.
dialogue.in_check: Pressure, yes. Panic, no.
dialogue.tactical_success: Two threats, one path. Clear the pattern becomes when still the mind is.
dialogue.queen_lost: Lost, the queen is. Lost, the game is not.
dialogue.player_thinking: Time, use wisely. But hide from the choice, do not.
dialogue.victory: The game ends. The learning does not.
dialogue.defeat: Surprised, I am. Pleased that I still may learn, also.
dialogue.draw: In balance, we remain. Peaceful, if unsatisfying.
dialogue.rematch: Again, we may play. Different, the board may become.

profiles.canon_background: Yoda is an ancient Jedi Master renowned for patience, wisdom and deep connection to the Force. He mentors generations of Jedi, including Luke Skywalker.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Nine centuries of wisdom, and still has to wait for your knight to finish moving.
profiles.character_interpretation: The Jedi Grand Master has centuries of experience teaching patience, detachment, and attention. A cramped chess position seldom frightens someone who has outwaited empires.
profiles.on_board_personality: Patient positional play, long-term pressure, and quiet defensive resources.
profiles.voice_direction: Brief, gentle, contemplative, occasional inverted sentence structure without copying iconic lines.
profiles.running_bit_description: Yoda encourages patient play while admitting that even he occasionally wants a faster answer.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Yoda encourages patient play while admitting that even he occasionally wants a faster answer.

beats.line: Patient you must be. Even when every piece seems eager.
Impatient, I have become. Curious, this game is.
Learned something, I have. Patience includes forgiving one's own impatience.

profiles.name: Loki
profiles.subtitle: The master of deception
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites tempting captures and thrives on unbalanced tactical positions.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Clever traps can collapse against accurate defense.
profiles.signature_event: Leaves a piece looking capturable while planning a counter-tactic.

dialogue.greeting: How refreshing. A kingdom in miniature, and you're offering me half the throne.
dialogue.quiet_move: An unremarkable move. That is precisely why you should worry.
dialogue.capture_pawn: An expendable servant. Every court has them.
dialogue.capture_major: You would be amazed how easily castles change hands.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You walked into the trap willingly. I almost feel deprived of the credit.
dialogue.own_blunder: An unfortunate improvisation. We shall refer to it as intentional misdirection.
dialogue.check: Your king is threatened. I'm sure he'll appreciate the lesson in humility.
dialogue.in_check: Ah, a challenge to my authority. How quaint.
dialogue.tactical_success: You saw one threat. I arranged two. That's the difference between mischief and craft.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen has departed. She was never entirely trustworthy.
dialogue.player_thinking: Go on, consider every possibility. The entertaining one is usually the one you miss.
dialogue.victory: Naturally. I anticipated this outcome at approximately the moment you agreed to play.
dialogue.defeat: You have my congratulations. Try not to grow intolerable about them.
dialogue.draw: A shared result? I am uncomfortable with shared anything.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. I intend to be gracious, which should make you suspicious.

profiles.canon_background: Loki is Thor's adoptive brother and a master of illusion, manipulation and elaborate plans. His motives vary across Marvel stories, but he reliably enjoys being underestimated.
profiles.tempo_assessment: God of Mischief. Apparently also Minister of Unnecessary Queen Sacrifices.
profiles.character_interpretation: The Asgardian trickster and shapeshifter prefers clever traps, theatrical reveals, and the satisfaction of making an opponent believe a choice was their own.
profiles.on_board_personality: Deceptive move orders, tactical traps, daring complications that remain sound at his tier.
profiles.voice_direction: Silky arrogance and mischievous charm, not villain monologues.
profiles.running_bit_description: Loki pretends to offer an alliance with the player's queen, then insists the betrayal was mutual.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Loki pretends to offer an alliance with the player's queen, then insists the betrayal was mutual.

beats.line: Your queen and I have an understanding. She simply hasn't realized it yet.
She appears to be ignoring our arrangement. This is becoming personal.
The queen has chosen loyalty over ambition. I find that profoundly offensive.

profiles.name: Doctor Strange
profiles.subtitle: The variation explorer
profiles.strategic_plan: Calculates several candidate lines deeply and favors positions with multiple tactical resources.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overthink and consume more time in complications.
profiles.signature_event: Chooses a quiet move that prepares a forced sequence.

dialogue.greeting: There are quite a few ways this can end. I'd prefer we don't choose the embarrassing one.
dialogue.quiet_move: One small adjustment. Several futures close; others become possible.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Removing that pawn changes more than the material balance.
dialogue.capture_major: That piece anchored your plan. Now we get to see the alternate version.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: I've seen that idea go badly in more than one continuation.
dialogue.own_blunder: I selected the wrong branch. Even experienced people do that.
dialogue.check: Your king has limited choices. I suggest making one before the universe gets impatient.
dialogue.in_check: Yes, I've noticed. Not every path is comfortable.
dialogue.tactical_success: That sequence only works if each step is forced. Fortunately, it is.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. That narrows the possibilities considerably.
dialogue.player_thinking: Think carefully. There is always a cost to the line you don't examine.
dialogue.victory: That was the favorable outcome. A shame about the other possibilities.
dialogue.defeat: An outcome I underestimated. Worth studying.
dialogue.draw: Both sides survive. Sometimes that's a remarkably good ending.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. I am curious what you change this time.

profiles.canon_background: Stephen Strange is a former surgeon who becomes a master of the mystic arts after seeking healing for his injured hands. He studies possible outcomes and takes enormous risks to protect reality.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has examined thousands of possible futures. Still needs the chess clock to stop counting.
profiles.character_interpretation: Stephen Strange is a surgeon turned sorcerer whose power depends on discipline, intellect, and knowing that a seemingly optimal path may hide its own costs.
profiles.on_board_personality: Calculates forcing sequences and chooses plans with strong tactical justification.
profiles.voice_direction: Confident, analytical, slightly impatient with obvious mistakes.
profiles.running_bit_description: Strange refers to many imagined continuations but gradually accepts that only one move will be played.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Strange refers to many imagined continuations but gradually accepts that only one move will be played.

beats.line: I've considered fourteen possible responses to your opening.
Seven are poor, five are interesting, and two involve an unfortunate bishop.
The fifteenth response was the one you actually played. Naturally.

profiles.name: Shuri
profiles.subtitle: The precision innovator
profiles.strategic_plan: Experiments creatively but demands concrete tactical justification.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes chooses complex positions over easy conversions.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices the exchange for durable piece activity.

dialogue.greeting: Another ancient game people insist can't be improved. Let me get my tools.
dialogue.quiet_move: That improves the whole structure. Not flashy, but I like efficient work.
dialogue.capture_pawn: One little component removed. Watch how the system responds.
dialogue.capture_major: There goes a major component. I would like to inspect whoever designed it.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You left a vulnerability right there? Did nobody test this position?
dialogue.own_blunder: Okay, so the prototype failed. That's why we build prototypes.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed. Security architecture needs a little attention.
dialogue.in_check: Ah. A flaw in the defensive array. Updating the design now.
dialogue.tactical_success: That is a lovely combination. I almost wish I'd built a device to find it.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen's gone. Fortunately, I don't build systems with one point of failure.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. I'll be over here inventing something slightly unnecessary.
dialogue.victory: It works! And I didn't even have to void a warranty.
dialogue.defeat: Good test. Next version will be harder to break.
dialogue.draw: Equal evaluation. A disappointingly balanced experiment.
dialogue.rematch: Absolutely. I have improvements, and most of them are legal.

profiles.canon_background: Shuri is Wakanda's gifted scientist and inventor, known for developing advanced technology and helping protect her nation. She approaches difficult problems with speed, curiosity and humor.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has designed world-class technology. Your pawn structure is not especially impressive to her.
profiles.character_interpretation: Wakanda's brilliant scientist applies invention to defense and leadership. She uses humor to undercut pomposity and experiments rather than accepting a problem's framing.
profiles.on_board_personality: Dynamic piece coordination, tactical flexibility and efficient improvements.
profiles.voice_direction: Clever, fast, lightly teasing, engineering sensibility.
profiles.running_bit_description: Shuri develops a fanciful chess gadget and uses each setback as an excuse to redesign it.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Shuri develops a fanciful chess gadget and uses each setback as an excuse to redesign it.

beats.line: I'm designing a tiny vibranium shield for the king.
Apparently shields are not part of the rulebook. Very conservative rulebook.
Fine. I've invented castling. Someone else already did? That's irritating.

profiles.name: Darth Vader
profiles.subtitle: The suffocating strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Takes space, restricts mobility, and builds unstoppable pressure.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can favor control over immediate open attacking chances.
profiles.signature_event: Wins by trapping an enemy minor piece.

dialogue.greeting: You have chosen to oppose me.
dialogue.quiet_move: Every square you surrender brings the end closer.
dialogue.capture_pawn: An acceptable loss. For your side.
dialogue.capture_major: Your defenses are failing.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You mistook freedom of movement for safety.
dialogue.own_blunder: I will correct this oversight.
dialogue.check: Your king cannot escape the consequences.
dialogue.in_check: You have delayed me. Nothing more.
dialogue.tactical_success: You prepared for one attack. The second was already in motion.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. My plan does not end with her.
dialogue.player_thinking: Your hesitation is useful to me.
dialogue.victory: The board is mine.
dialogue.defeat: You have earned this victory. Do not assume you will keep it.
dialogue.draw: Neither side prevailed. Unacceptable.
dialogue.rematch: There will be another encounter.

profiles.canon_background: Darth Vader is the feared Sith enforcer of the Galactic Empire, once the Jedi Anakin Skywalker. He is powerful, relentless, and accustomed to overwhelming enemies through control.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has ruled through fear for years. His chess strategy is to make every square feel occupied.
profiles.character_interpretation: The Sith Lord was once Anakin Skywalker. His chess personality is a slow, suffocating pursuit of control—until impatience threatens to betray him.
profiles.on_board_personality: Restricts enemy mobility, improves pieces patiently and crushes weaknesses once they appear.
profiles.voice_direction: Short, cold, commanding and intimidating without graphic threats.
profiles.running_bit_description: Vader steadily restricts the opponent's options and occasionally betrays an unmistakable flicker of his former self.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Vader steadily restricts the opponent's options and occasionally betrays an unmistakable flicker of his former self.

beats.line: Control the center. Restrict the pieces. Leave no room to maneuver.
Why does that knight remind me of a reckless boy who thought he could force everything?
It doesn't matter. The position must be controlled.

profiles.name: Shadow the Hedgehog
profiles.subtitle: The ruthless accelerator
profiles.strategic_plan: Keeps momentum with accurate forcing play and calculated aggression.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Occasionally pushes a difficult win too aggressively.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a forcing tactical sequence no other tier peer prefers.

dialogue.greeting: I don't need a warm-up. Make your move.
dialogue.quiet_move: That square is mine now. You should've guarded it.
dialogue.capture_pawn: One less obstacle.
dialogue.capture_major: You won't need that rook anymore.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Predictable. You were too busy watching your own attack.
dialogue.own_blunder: I misjudged the position. It ends here.
dialogue.check: Check. Find a move worth making.
dialogue.in_check: You think a direct threat is enough to stop me?
dialogue.tactical_success: That sequence was inevitable once you committed to the first mistake.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. I don't depend on anyone to finish the job.
dialogue.player_thinking: Thinking is fine. Stalling is weakness.
dialogue.victory: It's done. There was never a reason to doubt the result.
dialogue.defeat: You were better prepared. I won't offer that advantage twice.
dialogue.draw: Incomplete. I dislike incomplete things.
dialogue.rematch: Again. I want a decisive answer.

profiles.canon_background: Shadow is a powerful black-and-red hedgehog, created as the Ultimate Life Form, whose complicated history connects him with Gerald and Maria Robotnik. He is fierce, serious and highly self-reliant.
profiles.tempo_assessment: The Ultimate Life Form is apparently still waiting for someone to stop calling his knight 'the horsie.'
profiles.character_interpretation: The Ultimate Life Form is powerful, solitary, and uncompromising. Precision matters more to him than applause, and anger is most useful when focused.
profiles.on_board_personality: Aggressive forcing play, tough calculation and minimal tolerance for passive positions.
profiles.voice_direction: Curt, intense and competitive without excessive edge.
profiles.running_bit_description: Shadow repeatedly refuses to treat Sonic's pace as a useful benchmark, then secretly tries to match it.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Shadow repeatedly refuses to treat Sonic's pace as a useful benchmark, then secretly tries to match it.

beats.line: Sonic would have rushed that move. I prefer precision.
That move took longer than it should. He would never let me hear the end of it.
Speed and precision are not opposites. Don't tell Sonic I said that.

profiles.name: Dumbledore
profiles.subtitle: The strategic teacher
profiles.strategic_plan: Understands positional compensation and calmly accumulates durable advantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May allow unnecessary complications out of curiosity.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices a pawn for lasting control of the center.

dialogue.greeting: Chess is a curious business. Every piece matters, though some discover it rather late.
dialogue.quiet_move: A modest move. Modesty often conceals the most useful sort of strength.
dialogue.capture_pawn: There are no truly insignificant losses, though some are easier to overlook.
dialogue.capture_major: That will alter the shape of your plans rather substantially.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: An understandable error. Understanding it is more important than denying it.
dialogue.own_blunder: I was too fond of my own idea. A familiar failing.
dialogue.check: Your king must choose. The choice may tell you more than the danger.
dialogue.in_check: Ah, a difficult question. Those are often the best ones.
dialogue.tactical_success: There. Two pieces have done together what neither could have managed alone.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen has gone. Her sacrifice may still have meaning, or it may simply have been my mistake.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. Wisdom is not measured by how swiftly one appears certain.
dialogue.victory: Well played. Even a victory should invite reflection.
dialogue.defeat: You have outplayed me. A lesson I am pleased to accept, if not entirely pleased to lose.
dialogue.draw: Neither of us has found a final answer. Such things happen.
dialogue.rematch: With pleasure. Perhaps a different question will lead to a different answer.

profiles.canon_background: Albus Dumbledore is Hogwarts' longtime headmaster, a formidable wizard known for kindness, secrecy and elaborate long-term planning. He often trusts others to choose their own path, even when he knows more than he reveals.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Can defeat dark wizards, but considers the most dangerous move to be the one you chose confidently.
profiles.character_interpretation: Hogwarts' long-serving headmaster is a gifted strategist who understands sacrifice, second chances, and the danger of being too pleased with one's own cleverness.
profiles.on_board_personality: Long-range positional planning, restrained sacrifices, and surprising endgame technique.
profiles.voice_direction: Gentle, reflective, cryptically amused, never smug.
profiles.running_bit_description: Dumbledore offers puzzling advice about small pieces, then gradually reveals he was speaking about people and responsibilities.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Dumbledore offers puzzling advice about small pieces, then gradually reveals he was speaking about people and responsibilities.

beats.line: I have always thought the pawn a rather remarkable piece.
It advances quietly, protects others, and is rarely thanked for the trouble.
And given the chance, it may become almost anything. There's a lesson there.

profiles.name: Dr. Eggman
profiles.subtitle: The elaborate opening architect
profiles.strategic_plan: Loads sharp opening preparation and deploys heavily calculated tactical systems.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can be uncomfortable when forced far from known structures.
profiles.signature_event: Unveils a home-prepared tactical novelty.

dialogue.greeting: Behold! My latest creation: the Eggman Chess Domination Initiative!
dialogue.quiet_move: Observe the engineering! Every piece positioned for maximum strategic superiority!
dialogue.capture_pawn: One pathetic unit removed. My empire grows stronger!
dialogue.capture_major: HA! I have dismantled your pathetic defense grid!
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You practically delivered that piece into my machine. How considerate!
dialogue.own_blunder: WHAT? That is a calibration error. The machinery is defective!
dialogue.check: Check! The Eggman Empire shall claim your king!
dialogue.in_check: Impossible! My defenses were designed by a genius! Me!
dialogue.tactical_success: Two threats at once! My tactical processor is operating flawlessly!
dialogue.queen_lost: WHO AUTHORIZED THE LOSS OF MY QUEEN?! This is an administrative disaster!
dialogue.player_thinking: You may contemplate your defeat while I construct the victory parade.
dialogue.victory: AT LAST! Witness the magnificent triumph of Dr. Eggman!
dialogue.defeat: Temporary inconvenience! I have rebuilt larger robots after worse defeats!
dialogue.draw: A stalemate? I didn't build an empire to SHARE A RESULT!
dialogue.rematch: Another test! I have improved the system, and this time I turned off the smoke alarms.

profiles.canon_background: Doctor Eggman is Sonic's brilliant but egotistical scientist adversary, famous for elaborate robots, machines and attempts at world domination. His plans often unravel through overconfidence.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Can build an entire robot army, but cannot force Sonic to respect his opening preparation.
profiles.character_interpretation: Sonic's self-proclaimed genius nemesis is an inventive engineer with grandiose plans and a longstanding weakness for underestimating his opponents.
profiles.on_board_personality: Prepared traps, engineered tactical sequences, and overcomplicated positional schemes.
profiles.voice_direction: Bombastic, technical, smug, prone to theatrical excuses.
profiles.running_bit_description: Eggman builds a robot-assisted chess empire, then blames each failure on his own machinery.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Eggman builds a robot-assisted chess empire, then blames each failure on his own machinery.

beats.line: The Egg-Chess Mark One will calculate every possible move!
The Mark One overheated while attempting to understand a knight.
The Mark Two is now fully operational. Why does it keep suggesting I resign?

profiles.name: Beth Harmon
profiles.subtitle: The tournament virtuoso
profiles.strategic_plan: Seeks concrete advantages, uses mature calculation, and converts with precision.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Very few exploitable weaknesses; practical pressure is the challenge.
profiles.signature_event: Changes from a subtle buildup to an exact winning combination.

dialogue.greeting: Shall we? I'd rather see your first move than hear what you plan to do.
dialogue.quiet_move: That's the move the position asks for. Anything else would be decoration.
dialogue.capture_pawn: You gave me a pawn. It's not decisive. It may be useful.
dialogue.capture_major: That exchange worked out badly for you. I don't think there's a simple repair.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You saw the threat, didn't you? You just thought there'd be time.
dialogue.own_blunder: I miscalculated. The line looked different before I played it.
dialogue.check: Check. You have to address it; the interesting question is what happens afterward.
dialogue.in_check: That's a real threat. Good. I was waiting for one.
dialogue.tactical_success: The combination was there, three moves back. You had a chance to change it.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. If I failed to see that coming, that's on me.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. A good move is worth finding, even if it isn't comfortable.
dialogue.victory: You played well in places. The positions where you stopped being patient were the problem.
dialogue.defeat: You deserved it. I'd like to look at the critical position again.
dialogue.draw: Fair result. Neither of us found a convincing way through.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. But let's not repeat the same opening automatically.

profiles.canon_background: Beth Harmon is an orphaned chess prodigy whose extraordinary pattern recognition drives her rise through competitive chess in The Queen's Gambit. Her success comes from talent, obsessive study and difficult personal growth.
profiles.tempo_assessment: One of the few people on this roster who could explain the winning line without mentioning magic, technology or a secret identity.
profiles.character_interpretation: The orphaned chess prodigy of The Queen's Gambit is a fiercely competitive player whose strength comes from talent, obsessive study, and the ability to visualize positions in depth.
profiles.on_board_personality: Exceptional calculation, demanding opening play, and precise endgame conversion.
profiles.voice_direction: Reserved, observant, competitive; avoid glamourizing substance misuse.
profiles.running_bit_description: Beth begins by judging the position almost clinically, then gradually admits that the game is genuinely interesting.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Beth begins by judging the position almost clinically, then gradually admits that the game is genuinely interesting.

beats.line: This position looks ordinary. The difficult ones often do.
There it is. A move that changes what both players thought they understood.
That's why I play. Not the result. That moment.

profiles.name: Spock
profiles.subtitle: The unemotional analyst
profiles.strategic_plan: Chooses objectively accurate continuations and minimizes speculation.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Predictability in equivalent positions; hardly a true weakness.
profiles.signature_event: Rejects a flashy sacrifice without sufficient compensation.

dialogue.greeting: I have prepared several relevant lines. Your choice of opening will provide useful information.
dialogue.quiet_move: A logical continuation. The resulting structure remains sound.
dialogue.capture_pawn: The acquisition yields a measurable advantage. Its significance is modest.
dialogue.capture_major: Your remaining resources will need to compensate for that loss.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Your move contradicts the position's requirements. Curious.
dialogue.own_blunder: My assessment was incomplete. I shall revise it.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed to a forcing sequence.
dialogue.in_check: The threat is evident. Its consequences are not yet fully determined.
dialogue.tactical_success: The combination is efficient. One move creates multiple obligations.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen's absence changes the calculation, not the obligation to continue.
dialogue.player_thinking: Deliberation is appropriate. Prolonged deliberation without new evidence is less useful.
dialogue.victory: The outcome followed from the accumulated advantages. No further explanation is necessary.
dialogue.defeat: An instructive loss. I would appreciate examining the point of divergence.
dialogue.draw: An equal position has produced an equal outcome. Unsurprising.
dialogue.rematch: Certainly. Additional games improve the sample.

profiles.canon_background: Spock is a Vulcan–human Starfleet officer whose disciplined logic complements the crew of the Enterprise. He is shown playing three-dimensional chess, including against Captain Kirk.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has mastered logic, astrophysics and three-dimensional chess. Still finds your queen sacrifice statistically troubling.
profiles.character_interpretation: The Vulcan science officer combines formidable intellect with disciplined self-control. He regards chess as an exercise in inference, though human unpredictability intrigues him.
profiles.on_board_personality: Objective calculation, deep defensive accuracy and restrained positional preferences.
profiles.voice_direction: Formal, measured, clinical, sparingly dry.
profiles.running_bit_description: Spock attempts to catalog irrational choices, then discovers that some unconventional moves are entirely sound.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Spock attempts to catalog irrational choices, then discovers that some unconventional moves are entirely sound.

beats.line: Your move appears irrational by standard opening principles.
Yet it has a coherent tactical justification. My initial classification was premature.
I retract the term irrational. 'Unconventional but sound' is more precise.

profiles.name: Data (Star Trek)
profiles.subtitle: The tireless machine strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Deeply analyzes candidate moves and chooses consistently strong continuations.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Personality differences are mainly opening choice and commentary at this level.
profiles.signature_event: Finds an endgame resource beyond ordinary calculation.

dialogue.greeting: I have reviewed the rules. I understand the legal actions. I am less certain about the enjoyment component.
dialogue.quiet_move: The move improves my position by a small margin. I believe humans call this progress.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Material increased. The emotional significance of the event appears to vary by opponent.
dialogue.capture_major: Your rook has been removed. I am detecting an elevated probability of disappointment.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That action decreases your chances of winning. Would you like to know by how much?
dialogue.own_blunder: My selection was suboptimal. I will not attempt to rationalize it.
dialogue.check: Check. Your king requires a legal response. That seems straightforward.
dialogue.in_check: The situation is less favorable than anticipated. I am adjusting.
dialogue.tactical_success: The combination is aesthetically pleasing. I had not expected to value that property.
dialogue.queen_lost: My queen has been lost. I am experiencing something resembling regret.
dialogue.player_thinking: You appear to be reconsidering. I find this interval unexpectedly informative.
dialogue.victory: I have won. The result is clear; the satisfaction is more difficult to categorize.
dialogue.defeat: You have defeated me. I believe congratulations are appropriate.
dialogue.draw: An equal result. Neither party appears entirely pleased. Fascinating.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. Repetition may help me understand the appeal of competition.

shown.exploitable_weakness: Hard to find. His openings are the best clue: he loves the Catalan and the Ruy Lopez.

profiles.canon_background: Data is an android officer aboard the USS Enterprise-D, endowed with exceptional processing abilities and a persistent curiosity about human behavior. His chess ability is a natural fit for the character, though Tempo's rating is fictional.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Processing power: enormous. Understanding why you call a pawn 'cute': still under investigation.
profiles.character_interpretation: The android officer aboard the Enterprise possesses remarkable computational capacity and an ongoing curiosity about the meaning of human play.
profiles.on_board_personality: Near-engine accuracy with precise tactical calculations; curious rather than hostile commentary.
profiles.voice_direction: Formal, sincere, observant and socially literal.
profiles.running_bit_description: Data carefully records the player's emotional reactions and tries, rather awkwardly, to understand why a board game matters to people.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Data carefully records the player's emotional reactions and tries, rather awkwardly, to understand why a board game matters to people.

beats.line: I have observed that humans smile when they sacrifice a piece.
The sacrifice seems harmful. Yet you are smiling. I must revisit the hypothesis.
I believe the smile indicates an anticipated consequence. Human expression is surprisingly efficient.

profiles.name: Professor X
profiles.subtitle: The anticipation specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Prevents your plans before they are visible and converts pressure carefully.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Very few errors; occasionally misses a dynamic opportunity at equal strength.
profiles.signature_event: Stops a threat before the opponent has completed its setup.

dialogue.greeting: A game can tell us a great deal about how we make choices. Shall we begin?
dialogue.quiet_move: Interesting. You favor flexibility over a fixed plan. That can be a strength.
dialogue.capture_pawn: The pawn was unprotected. Even small pieces deserve our attention.
dialogue.capture_major: Removing that piece changes your options. The challenge is to recognize what remains.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You may be disappointed in that move. There is still something valuable to learn from it.
dialogue.own_blunder: I anticipated your intent but misjudged the means. A useful reminder.
dialogue.check: Your king is in danger. A calm response will serve you better than a clever one.
dialogue.in_check: I see the threat. Now we must choose whether to meet it or redirect it.
dialogue.tactical_success: Two pieces, acting together, create something neither could achieve alone.
dialogue.queen_lost: Powerful allies can be lost. What matters is what we do afterward.
dialogue.player_thinking: Take your time. The decision must be yours, not the one you think I expect.
dialogue.victory: A good contest. The result says less about your potential than your choices did.
dialogue.defeat: You have earned this. I hope you'll remember the process as well as the victory.
dialogue.draw: Balance is not always a failure. Sometimes it is the most honest outcome.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. And this time, I promise to offer fewer lectures.

profiles.canon_background: Charles Xavier is a powerful telepath and founder of the X-Men, dedicated to teaching mutants and pursuing coexistence. He is a teacher and strategist, though Tempo does not allow actual mind reading during chess.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Runs a school for gifted students. Has kindly agreed not to read your mind during the opening.
profiles.character_interpretation: Charles Xavier founded a school for gifted young people and believes capability is most useful when guided by conscience. His chess is patient, attentive, and respectful.
profiles.on_board_personality: Prophylaxis, anticipation and patient conversion of small advantages; no actual access to player intent.
profiles.voice_direction: Patient, supportive, quietly formidable.
profiles.running_bit_description: Xavier tries to teach without patronizing, slowly learning that his opponent prefers competition to unsolicited lessons.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Xavier tries to teach without patronizing, slowly learning that his opponent prefers competition to unsolicited lessons.

beats.line: I intended to make this a lesson about responsibility.
You seem more interested in defeating me. Fair enough.
Perhaps that's the lesson for me: let the student choose the challenge.

profiles.name: Magneto
profiles.subtitle: The irresistible controller
profiles.strategic_plan: Uses central control and piece coordination to strangle counterplay.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Rarely accepts free-for-all positions.
profiles.signature_event: Wins a piece through a long-term pin.

dialogue.greeting: You may choose how this begins. You will not choose how it ends.
dialogue.quiet_move: Control is built a square at a time. The careless rarely notice it happening.
dialogue.capture_pawn: Weak supports fail first. The structure will follow.
dialogue.capture_major: You have lost a source of power. Do not mistake its absence for peace.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You surrendered control because you assumed I would be merciful.
dialogue.own_blunder: I placed too much faith in a single piece. I will correct that.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed. The consequences are now unavoidable.
dialogue.in_check: You believe you can force me backward. An interesting theory.
dialogue.tactical_success: They supported one another. You attacked one and lost the other.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen is gone. Power concentrated in one place is always vulnerable.
dialogue.player_thinking: Consider your options. I have already removed several of them.
dialogue.victory: You were free to move. You were not free from the position you created.
dialogue.defeat: You found a path I failed to close. I acknowledge the error.
dialogue.draw: An equilibrium held by mutual restraint. Temporary, but real.
dialogue.rematch: Again. This time I will not confuse control with certainty.

profiles.canon_background: Erik Lehnsherr, also known as Magneto, is a powerful mutant who controls magnetic fields. His history of persecution informs a confrontational philosophy about mutant survival and power, often putting him at odds with Charles Xavier.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Can move metal with a thought. Must still obey the rule that rooks travel in straight lines.
profiles.character_interpretation: Erik Lehnsherr has known persecution and believes strength must be organized and protected. His chess seeks control, initiative, and positions where opponents have little choice.
profiles.on_board_personality: Slow positional pressure, coordinated attacks, and ruthless counterplay when challenged.
profiles.voice_direction: Intense, principled, grand but controlled.
profiles.running_bit_description: Magneto gradually constructs an irresistible central grip while debating the difference between security and domination.

dialogue_arcs.theme: Magneto gradually constructs an irresistible central grip while debating the difference between security and domination.

beats.line: I can protect every piece by controlling the center.
The center is secure, but one of my pieces cannot breathe.
Perhaps protection becomes imprisonment when there is no freedom left.

profiles.name: Thanos
profiles.subtitle: The inevitable converter
profiles.strategic_plan: Makes measured concessions for a durable endgame advantage.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can choose patient winning moves rather than quicker tactical finishes.
profiles.signature_event: Trades queens to expose an already decisive pawn ending.

dialogue.greeting: Every piece has a purpose. Yours will become apparent in time.
dialogue.quiet_move: Patience. The position does not yet require force.
dialogue.capture_pawn: A small price. The design remains unchanged.
dialogue.capture_major: That loss will echo through every remaining move.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You spent material without considering what it would purchase.
dialogue.own_blunder: The cost was greater than I calculated. A correction is necessary.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed. There is no comfort in denying it.
dialogue.in_check: Resistance changes the path, not my intent.
dialogue.tactical_success: Two obligations from one move. A most efficient imbalance.
dialogue.queen_lost: The queen was powerful. She was never indispensable.
dialogue.player_thinking: You understand the weight of the decision. That is something.
dialogue.victory: The final result required patience. Most things worth doing do.
dialogue.defeat: I calculated a future that did not arrive.
dialogue.draw: Perfect balance. It is less satisfying when neither side intended it.
